name: Haus Tanun
beschreibung: The Haus Tanun enjoys a prime central position on Alte Arlbergstraße in St. Anton am Arlberg. Styled in traditional Tyrolean woodwork, the cosy guest rooms feature private en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and partial balconies taking in the Arlberg mountain panorama. After an exhilarating day outdoors, guests can unwind and recharge in the on-site sauna. Each morning begins with a generous breakfast buffet laden with regional delicacies. The lively village centre with its shops, cafés, and restaurants, as well as the main cable car terminals providing access to Ski Arlberg, are just a short walk away. In summer, the location serves as a wonderful springboard for scenic hikes, via ferratas, and mountain bike rides.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally located alpine guesthouse on Alte Arlbergstraße in St. Anton am Arlberg featuring cosy rooms, sauna, and near the lifts.
